definitions.gloss: approval or disapproval; yes or no; propriety
definitions.explanation: Whether something is acceptable or not; the question of approval versus rejection. Composed of 可 (acceptable, permissible) + 否 (not, negative). Used in formal and business contexts to discuss whether something should be approved or whether it is appropriate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可否|かひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let us know whether you can attend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可否|かひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}する→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧。
examples.english: The committee will discuss whether to approve this proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可否|かひ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check with the facility in advance regarding whether photography is permitted.

notes:
USAGE:
{可否|かひ} is a formal word used mainly in written communication, business emails, and official documents. In everyday speech, people would simply ask ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧ or ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可否|かひ} (whether one can participate)
- {可否|かひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ (to question the propriety of)
- {可否|かひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (to judge approval/disapproval)
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{可否|かひ} (whether photography is allowed)
- ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可否|かひ} (whether one can attend)
